== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Hugh Glasgow, preacher of the gospel, indexed 1677. Hugh Glasgow was described in a 1677 printed Register of Deeds index as “preacher of the gospel.” The index lists him as grantee in a deed abbreviated “Transl.”, recorded 8 March 1677 in the Durie Office, volume 42, page 148 (National Records of Scotland RD3/42, p. 148). The underlying deed has not been examined. The identification remains uncertain.<ref>FamilySearch, ''Scotland. Land Records 1677'', item #007830797, Item 3, image 48; printed ''Register of Deeds, 1677. Name and Designation'', vol. XVII, p.80, Hugh Glasgow; Durie Office vol.42 p.148, National Records of Scotland RD3/42. [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS39-S9V2-4?view=fullText&keywords=HUGH+Glasgow&searchForm=simple&lang=en&groupId=M9QN-ZQ3 printed index image].</ref>
